question_text: The Freedom of Information (FOI) Program in the Philippines, established through Executive Order No. 2 series of 2016, promotes transparency and accountability in government. It allows citizens to request access to official documents and records from executive branch agencies, subject to certain exceptions such as national security and privacy. The program aims to empower the public and enhance participatory governance. According to the passage, which of the following is an exception to the FOI Program?

options.text: Information that may compromise national security
